scope: Suitability (completeness) check of food enzyme applications under Regulations (EC) No 1331/2008 and (EU) No 234/2011. The items follow the rows of EFSA's 'Suitability checklist for food enzyme applications' (Appendix A to EFSA Supporting Publication 2021:EN-6509), which states it is based on the requirements of the EFSA Scientific Guidance for the submission of dossiers on Food Enzymes. Each item quotes that scientific guidance: the bundled copy is the public-consultation draft hosted by EFSA (2021); the adopted guidance is EFSA Journal 2021;19(10):6851. Part A (new food enzyme) and Part B (modification of an existing authorisation, e.g. extension of use) are distinguished. Neither Appendix A nor the adopted guidance could be downloaded for bundling here: verify wording against them.
